content.text: 本机 memory 仓已有近期 merge，接着跑完整双机同步并核对两边 hosts。

input.command: bash ~/.dc-platform/scripts/prepare_daily_report_sync.sh 2026-11-05 2>&1; echo '---EXIT---'; echo $?; ls -la ~/.dc-platform/memory/work-log/hosts/new-mac/ ~/.dc-platform/memory/work-log/hosts/old-mac/ 2>&1 | head -40; echo '---'; ls -la ~/.dc-platform/memory/work-log/hosts/new-mac/2026-11-05.md ~/.dc-platform/memory/work-log/hosts/old-mac/2026-11-05.md ~/.dc-platform/memory/work-log/2026-11-05.md 2>&1; echo '---STATUS---'; git -C ~/.dc-platform/memory status -sb; git -C ~/.dc-platform/memory log -3 --oneline; echo '---HOSTID---'; cat ~/.dc-platform/config/host_id 2>/dev/null || cat ~/.dc-platform/memory/config/host_id 2>/dev/null || (grep -r 'HOST\|old-mac\|new-mac' ~/.dc-platform/config/memory_sync.env 2>/dev/null; hostname -s)
input.description: Run dual-mac memory sync and verify

input.command:
# 核对双机 hosts 与近期沉淀；确认 remote 对齐
git -C ~/.dc-platform/memory status -sb
git -C ~/.dc-platform/memory log -5 --oneline
echo '=== hosts ==='
wc -l ~/.dc-platform/memory/work-log/hosts/new-mac/2026-11-05.md ~/.dc-platform/memory/work-log/hosts/old-mac/2026-11-05.md ~/.dc-platform/memory/work-log/2026-11-05.md 2>&1
echo '=== recent lessons/feedback (mtime top) ==='
ls -lt ~/.dc-platform/memory/lessons/*.md ~/.dc-platform/memory/feedback_*.md ~/.dc-platform/memory/pinned/*.md 2>/dev/null | head -15
echo '=== launchd sync ==='
launchctl list 2>/dev/null | grep -i memory || true
ls ~/Library/LaunchAgents/com.youchu.memory* 2>/dev/null
# new-mac 能否触达？不一定能 SSH，但报清本机结果
cat ~/.dc-platform/config/memory_sync.env 2>/dev/null | head -20
grep -cE '^- ' ~/.dc-platform/memory/work-log/hosts/new-mac/2026-11-05.md ~/.dc-platform/memory/work-log/hosts/old-mac/2026-11-05.md 2>/dev/null
input.description: Verify sync alignment and hosts bullets
